title: Script and Event Handling
use_cases: Run lifecycle script (post-install-cmd, pre-install-cmd, post-update-cmd, pre-update-cmd)
Dispatch package event (pre-package-install, post-package-install, pre-package-update, post-package-update, pre-package-uninstall, post-package-uninstall)
actor_use_case_relationships: Plugin --> Register plugin as event subscriber
include_extend_relationships: Run lifecycle script <<include>> Dispatch script event via EventDispatcher.dispatchScript()
Run custom script <<include>> Dispatch script event via EventDispatcher.dispatchScript()
Register plugin as event subscriber <<include>> EventDispatcher.addSubscriber(plugin)

Script\\Event.notes: Carries Composer instance + IO into script handlers; supports originating event chain

key_methods: dispatchScript(eventName, devMode, additionalArgs[], flags[]): int — creates ScriptEvent, calls doDispatch()
dispatchPackageEvent(eventName, devMode, localRepo, operations[], operation): int
EventDispatcher.notes: Central hub; dispatchScript() wraps ScriptEvent; listeners come from composer.json scripts[] or plugin subscribers

key_methods: loadInstalledPlugins() — loads local + global repo plugins
registerPackage(package, failOnMissingClasses, isGlobalPlugin) — validates API version, checks allow-plugins, calls addPlugin()
addPlugin(PluginInterface, isGlobalPlugin, ?sourcePackage) — calls plugin.activate(composer, io); if EventSubscriberInterface, calls eventDispatcher.addSubscriber(plugin)
isPluginAllowed(package, isGlobalPlugin, optional, prompt): bool — checks allow-plugins config, prompts interactively
PluginManager.notes: allow-plugins security gate; plugins implementing EventSubscriberInterface auto-subscribe to EventDispatcher

BaseCommand.notes: Abstract base for all Composer commands; --no-scripts / --no-plugins flags control script/plugin execution

interaction_flow: Developer runs 'composer install/update' → BaseCommand.requireComposer() → Composer instance created
EventDispatcher creates Script\Event, iterates listeners from composer.json scripts[] and plugin subscribers
InstallationManager.execute() called with runScripts=true → downloadAndExecuteBatch() → executeBatch()
Plugin's subscribed methods called when matching events dispatched
key_relationships: BaseCommand uses Composer which owns EventDispatcher
important_notes: Scripts run only if runScripts=true AND eventDispatcher != null in InstallationManager. --no-scripts / --no-plugins flags on BaseCommand suppress script/plugin execution. Plugin allow-plugins config gates plugin registration; PluginManager prompts interactively if missing. Plugins implementing EventSubscriberInterface auto-register to EventDispatcher via addSubscriber(). Script\Event carries Composer + IOInterface for use in PHP script callbacks.
